start: ^I am a priest of the course of Abijah. At the ninth hour — the exact hour of the evening sacrifice — the earth shook. The great inner curtain tore from top to bottom. I was inside the Holy Place when it happened. The presence of God... departed. The Temple is finished. Not destroyed. Finished. Completed. Fulfilled. And the man on the cross... He is the reason.

c-0: ^I saw Him from the courtyard. He cried out with a loud voice: 'Father, into your hands I commit my spirit.' And then He bowed His head and died. No suffering. No struggle. He gave up His spirit willingly. Psalm 31:5 — 'Into your hands I commit my spirit.' He died with a prayer on His lips. No crucifixion victim dies like that.
c-1: ^The curtain tore from top to bottom. Not from human hands. From divine hands. The way into the Most Holy Place — the place only the High Priest could enter once a year — is now open. To everyone. To the Gentiles. To the outcasts. To the world. The old covenant is over. The new covenant has begun. And the mediator is a man on a cross.
